_note: This file documents the raw-discovery.json schema produced by ingest.py. It is a static reference — not read or written by any pipeline component. The real output file (raw-discovery.json, gitignored) is overwritten on every ingest run.

items.item_title: Raw title exactly as it appears in the feed
items.feed_description: Raw HTML description from the feed <description> element.
Brief plain-text teaser from the Atom <summary> element.

skipped.reason: no feed_url — deferred to deterministic page-check path

_schema_notes.item_id: Deterministic: 'raw-{source_id}-{sha1(item_url)[:8]}'. Stable across runs for the same URL. Enables future exact-URL cross-run dedup.
_schema_notes.item_url: URL of the individual article/entry. Stored as an untrusted string — never fetched in v1.
_schema_notes.feed_description: Raw description/summary field from the feed. Explicitly untrusted source material. May be HTML, plain text, or null. Never a public AInetWatch summary.
_schema_notes.feed_description_format: 'html' | 'text' | null. Inferred from Atom type attribute or HTML heuristic for RSS. null means field is absent or empty.
_schema_notes.fetch_method: 'rss' for RSS 2.0 feeds, 'atom' for Atom 1.0 feeds. 'page' is reserved for the future deterministic page-check path.
_schema_notes.priority_filter: Which registry priority tier was ingested this run. Always 'high' in v1.
_schema_notes.skipped: High-priority sources without a feed_url — deferred to the deterministic page-check path (future issue).
_schema_notes.errors: Per-source fetch/parse failures. Run continues after each error; partial output is still written.
